dlc.title: Batman Classic TV Series Batmobile Pack
Season of Infamy: Most Wanted Expansion

roadmap.title: Story campaign
roadmap.description: Play the main missions and boss fights of the first playthrough.

roadmap.title: Open-world operations
roadmap.description: Clear weapons caches, checkpoints, watchtowers, APCs, explosives, fires and the side-mission supervillains.

roadmap.title: Riddler trials and trophies
roadmap.description: Complete the Riddler trials, collect the trophies and lock up the Riddler.

roadmap.title: Skill challenges
roadmap.description: Finish the combat, gliding and Batmobile feats.

roadmap.title: New Story +
roadmap.description: Beat the main missions again on New Story +.

roadmap.title: DLC story packs and Season of Infamy
roadmap.description: Play the story packs and Season of Infamy missions.

roadmap.title: AR challenge stars
roadmap.description: Earn the AR Challenge stars for the base game, each character and each Batmobile.

roadmap.title: Crime Fighter challenge packs
roadmap.description: Finish the special AR challenge runs.

achievements.description: Defeat the Militia battalion and rescue Stagg during the Going Stagg mission.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Militia battalion and rescue Stagg during the Going Stagg mission.

steps.text: Fight the Militia soldiers attacking Stagg until Stagg is saved.
Play through the Joker attack that follows.

achievements.description: Secure the Quarantine Cells by taking Harley down together with Robin.
achievements.summary: Secure the Quarantine Cells by taking Harley down together with Robin.

steps.text: Hide in the Floor Grates and use the Voice Synthesizer so a thug opens the Security Gate to the @loc{Quarantine Cells}.
When Harley arrives, defeat her with a Dual Team Takedown with Robin.

achievements.description: Achieve 69 Stars in AR Challenges.
achievements.summary: Earn 69 stars in AR Challenges as Batman.

steps.text: Keep earning stars in Combat, Predator and Batmobile Race Challenges as Batman.
Stop when your Batman star total reaches 69.

achievements.description: Complete the Heir to the Cowl side mission.
achievements.summary: Complete the Heir to the Cowl side mission.

steps.text: Complete each Heir to the Cowl trial with Azrael.
Choose how the final mission ends and finish it.

achievements.description: Escape from ACE Chemicals in the Batmobile before the facility explodes.
achievements.summary: Escape from ACE Chemicals in the Batmobile before the facility explodes.

steps.text: Return to Batman at @loc{Ace Chemicals} after the Gordon flashback mission.
Drive the @item{Batmobile} out of the facility before it explodes.

achievements.description: Defeat three waves of Militia soldiers on the GCPD rooftop after the tank battle.
achievements.summary: Defeat three waves of Militia soldiers on the GCPD rooftop after the tank battle.

steps.text: Defeat the Drone army in the tank battle outside @loc{GCPD}.
Go to the rooftop and defeat three waves of Militia soldiers.

achievements.description: Destroy the second weapons cache in Gotham City.
achievements.summary: Blow up the second Weapons Cache by finishing the second Gunrunner stage.

steps.text: Plant a tracker on a Refrigeration Van at @loc{Panessa Studios} or @loc{The Cauldron} and tail it to the abandoned Sionis Industries building.
Open the main gate with the Remote Hacking Device and destroy the two Sentry Guns with the @item{Batmobile}.
Open the rooftop shutters, drop in, and defeat the thugs with Nightwing.
Gel the Weapons Crate, close the vault, and detonate the gel.

achievements.description: Complete 8 different jumps over 100 meters.
achievements.summary: Complete 8 different jumps of more than 100 meters.

guide.context: Your progress is not shown, and a jump may not register the first time, so repeat any jump you are unsure about.

steps.text: Find 8 different jump spots and drive the Batmobile off the edge of each with enough speed to travel more than 100 meters.
Place a waypoint where you expect to land to check the horizontal distance, and repeat the jump if unsure it counted.

achievements.description: Destroy the third weapons cache in Gotham City.
achievements.summary: Blow up the third Weapons Cache by finishing the third Gunrunner stage.

steps.text: Plant a tracker on another Refrigeration Van and follow it to the hideout in the @loc{Founders' Island} undercity.
Enter through the door guarded by a sniper and clear the thugs.
Blow the cache up with Explosive Gel inside the vault.

achievements.description: Perform every type of predator takedown.
achievements.summary: Perform all 21 types of Predator takedown.

guide.context: A Takedown Smash counts as its own move, so skip it while logging the others.

steps.text: Anywhere: Silent Takedown, Knockout Smash, Glide Kick, Drop Attack, Drop Down Takedown, Swing Down Takedown (use the Grapnel in the swing), Smoke Pellet Takedown, Fear Multi-Takedown (2 or more enemies) and Line Launcher Takedown.
Common situational: Ledge Takedown, Corner Cover Takedown (Batclaw pull), Environment Takedown (blue highlighted objects), Floor Grate Takedown.
Uncommon: Window Takedown, Wooden Paneling Takedown, Ceiling Takedown, Wall Grate Takedown, Inverted Takedown.
Rare: Grapnel Takedown (Grapnel to a ledge spot in front of an enemy without boosting), Service Hatch Takedown from above and from below.
Do each once in the campaign or in Predator challenges started from the open world, and do not add a Takedown Smash to a move you are logging.

achievements.description: Help Robin fight off the thugs in the Quarantine Cells at Panessa Studios.
achievements.summary: Help Robin fight off the thugs in the Quarantine Cells at Panessa Studios.

steps.text: In Assault On Panessa Studios, trick the gate with the @item{Voice Synthesizer} and beat Harley's outside thugs.
Enter the Quarantine Cells and help Robin defeat the attacking thugs.

achievements.description: Defend the assault on your ally's fortress.
achievements.summary: Destroy the first wave of Drones and the five Cobra Drones sent next during the Ivy's Revenge mission.

steps.text: In the Ivy's Revenge mission on @loc{Miagani Island}, defeat the first wave of Drones.
Destroy the five @enemy{Cobra Drones} that arrive next.

achievements.description: Destroy the first weapons cache in Gotham City.
achievements.summary: Blow up Penguin's first Weapons Cache with Explosive Gel.

steps.text: Confront Penguin with Nightwing's help.
Use @item{Explosive Gel} and close the vault door to destroy the cache.

achievements.description: Freedom of the city.
achievements.summary: Destroy the Long Range Missile Launcher during the Vengeance story mission.

steps.text: In the Vengeance mission, take out the Cobra Tanks and follow the marked path to the lowered half-bridge.
Raise the half-bridge with the @mechanic{Power Winch} and jump onto the building ahead.
Stop the Arkham Knight's soldiers, then cross the ramp in the @item{Batmobile}.
Destroy the Long Range Missile Launcher with the secondary weapon.

achievements.description: Use 100 Quick Gadgets while in free flow combat.
achievements.summary: Use 100 Quick Gadgets during freeflow combat.

steps.text: Mid-fight on foot, fire off quick gadgets: a thrown Batarang, the Batclaw, a Freeze Blast or the Remote Electrical Charge.
Keep doing this until you reach 100 uses.

achievements.description: Destroy the Militia Commander's tank in the final Campaign For Disarmament fight and take him to GCPD.
achievements.summary: Destroy the Militia Commander's tank in the final Campaign For Disarmament fight and take him to GCPD.

steps.text: After the 14th explosive device, start the last Campaign For Disarmament fight in @loc{Grand Avenue}.
Destroy the Commander's five @enemy{Cobra Drones} without being seen, then destroy his tank with the 60mm Cannon.
Load the Commander into the @item{Batmobile} and take him to the @loc{GCPD Precinct}.

achievements.displayName: Dark Wings Fly Away in Fear
achievements.description: Reach the Cloudburst Chamber on Stagg Airship Beta and confront Scarecrow.
achievements.summary: Reach the Cloudburst Chamber on Stagg Airship Beta and confront Scarecrow.

steps.text: Finish the Stagg Airship Beta sections of Going Stagg.
Enter the @loc{Cloudburst Chamber} and confront @npc{Scarecrow}.

achievements.description: Extinguish the fires in Gotham City.
achievements.summary: Extinguish the fires in Gotham City.

steps.text: Open Gotham On Fire from the Most Wanted wheel and put out each burning fire station.
At the Otisburg fire station, pursue Firefly until his fuel is gone, then tackle him.

achievements.description: Perform 15 different combat moves in one FreeFlow.
achievements.summary: Chain 15 distinct combat moves inside a single FreeFlow combo.

guide.context: AR challenges count only when started from the open world, not from the main menu.

steps.text: Open an AR Challenge from the open world, such as Gotham Knights, and buy the Special Takedown upgrades first.
Start a FreeFlow combo and use 15 different moves, including quick gadgets and dual-team takedowns, without losing it.

achievements.description: Perform 20 fear takedowns.
achievements.summary: Perform 20 Fear Takedowns.

guide.context: Each completed Fear Takedown counts once, no matter how many enemies it hits.

steps.text: Replay the Fear Multi-Takedown training AR Challenge on the roof of the Falcone Shipping Antenna area, which gives 4 Fear Takedowns each time.
Alternatively, use Fear Multi-Takedowns on enemies while playing.

achievements.description: Obtain a key by completing the seventh Riddler trial.
achievements.summary: Finish the seventh Riddler trial and collect the key it awards.

steps.text: Go to Divinity Church in @loc{Otisburg} on Founders' Island.
Lower the Batmobile with the Anchor Point, rotate the wall panels with its wheels, and glide through the holes to the pressure pad.
Destroy the two turrets by remote control.
As Catwoman, walk around the left side of the containers to the row of three, go two squares forward from the rightmost one, and take the key.

achievements.description: Rescue station 17 fire crew.
achievements.summary: Rescue all 15 missing Station 17 firefighters and Fire Chief Underhill in The Line of Duty side mission.

steps.text: Open The Line of Duty from the Most Wanted wheel and rescue each missing Station 17 firefighter.
After the last firefighter, go to the marked location and defeat the Gun Thugs in the predator section.
Rescue Chief Underhill and take him to the @loc{GCPD Precinct}.

achievements.description: Counter the assailant in the Friend In Need side mission at Wayne Tower.
achievements.summary: Counter the assailant in the Friend In Need side mission at Wayne Tower.

steps.text: Visit Mr. Fox in the @loc{Wayne Tower} parking garage.
Confront the assailant and Counter him when he points the gun.

achievements.description: Smash 10 militia transport vehicles off the road without using the immobilizer.
achievements.summary: Destroy 10 Militia Transport vehicles without using the Immobilizer.

steps.text: Find Militia Transports escorting the APC in Armed & Dangerous missions.
Ram them with Boost or side swipe them until 10 are destroyed, never firing the Immobilizer at them.

achievements.description: Rescue the ACE Chemical workers.
achievements.summary: Rescue the five missing ACE Chemicals workers and deliver them to Commissioner Gordon.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Ace Chemicals} and hack the systems to find the five missing workers.
Rescue all five, then defeat the Militia helicopter with the @item{Batmobile}.
Escape with the workers and deliver them to @npc{Commissioner Gordon}.

achievements.description: Defeat the Drone attack Scarecrow sends after you.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Drone attack Scarecrow sends after you.

steps.text: Defeat the Drone encounter Scarecrow sends.

achievements.description: Achieve 46 Stars in AR Challenges.
achievements.summary: Earn 46 stars in AR Challenges as Batman.

steps.text: Keep earning stars in Combat, Predator and Batmobile Race Challenges as Batman.
Stop when your Batman star total reaches 46.

achievements.description: Destroy all of the militia watchtowers.
achievements.summary: Destroy all 21 Militia watchtowers.

steps.text: Open Occupy Gotham from the Most Wanted wheel.
At each @loc{Militia Watchtower}, defeat the soldiers and destroy the Watchtower Command Console.

achievements.description: Glide for 400 meters while less than 20 meters from the ground.
achievements.summary: Glide 400 meters while staying less than 20 meters above the ground.

guide.context: Rising above 20 meters voids the flight, so you must start over.

steps.text: Grapnel boost from a high point, then dive bomb and pull up near the ground to keep your speed.
Keep gliding low for 400 meters in one flight; Miagani or Bleake Island is easier than Founders Island.

achievements.description: Defuse all of the militia explosive ordinance in Gotham City.
achievements.summary: Disarm all 15 Militia explosive devices in Gotham City.

steps.text: Open Campaign For Disarmament from the Most Wanted wheel.
At each @item{Militia Explosive Device}, upload the virus and destroy the Militia Drones that arrive.

achievements.description: Stop the bank heist on Miagani Island and lock up the master mind in GCPD.
achievements.summary: Stop the third bank robbery in Kingston and take Two-Face to GCPD.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{Bank of Gotham} in Kingston on Miagani Island.
Defeat 15 Gun Thugs, then Two-Face and his Militia backup.
Load Two-Face into the @item{Batmobile} and drive him to the @loc{GCPD Precinct}.

achievements.description: Even The Odds.
achievements.summary: Rescue Officer Kevern and enter the Batmobile for the first time.

steps.text: Play the opening Gotham Overrun mission through the Chinatown fight.
Rescue @npc{Officer Kevern}, then get into the @item{Batmobile}.

achievements.description: Win the rumble down under.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Arkham Knight's Excavator in the maze-like room during the Rescuing the Commissioner mission.

steps.text: After the ramp jump in the excavator tunnels, escape the Excavator's first attack.
In the maze-like room, lure the Excavator down each of the three marked tunnels (north, east and south) so it detonates its explosives; touching it is an instant death.

achievements.description: Finish every Most Wanted side mission, then use the Bat Signal on the GCPD roof.
achievements.summary: Finish every Most Wanted side mission, then use the Bat Signal on the GCPD roof.

steps.text: Finish every Most Wanted side mission.
Go to the Bat Signal on top of the @loc{GCPD Precinct} and activate it.

achievements.description: Obtain a key by completing the ninth Riddler trial.
achievements.summary: Finish the ninth Riddler trial and collect the key it awards.

steps.text: Enter the Ranelagh Ferry Terminal in @loc{Kingston}.
Finish the three-lap Batmobile race; on the last lap the Riddler controls the green and red mechanisms.
As Catwoman, go to the row of five containers and take the key from the closest container branching off the next row.

achievements.description: Interrogate the Militia APC Driver.
achievements.summary: Interrogate the Militia APC driver.

steps.text: Chase the Arkham Knight's convoy in the @item{Batmobile}.
Disable the Militia APC with the @mechanic{Immobilizer}.
Interrogate the driver.

achievements.description: Defeat Pyg and take him and his captives out of the Pretty Dolls Parlor to GCPD.
achievements.summary: Defeat Pyg and take him and his captives out of the Pretty Dolls Parlor to GCPD.

steps.text: Follow The Perfect Crime side mission to the @loc{Founders' Island} undercity, ending at the Pretty Dolls Parlor.
In the Operating Theater, knock out Pyg's zombies, then slam @enemy{Pyg} into the operating table.
Free the captives and drive Pyg to the @loc{GCPD Precinct} in the @item{Batmobile}.

achievements.description: Surrender to Scarecrow and survive the sequence that ends at Arkham Asylum.
achievements.summary: Surrender to Scarecrow and survive the sequence that ends at Arkham Asylum.

steps.text: In Ending the Nightmare, enter the Gotham Storage Depot in Kingston and surrender your gadgets to Scarecrow.
Get into the transport truck and play through the sequence until you reach @loc{Arkham Asylum}.

achievements.description: Obtain a key by completing the last Riddler trial.
achievements.summary: Finish the final Riddler trial and collect the key it awards.

steps.text: Return to @loc{Pinkney Orphanage} and enter the Final Exam trial room.
Shift the pressure pad blocks with the Remote Electrical Charge and the Industrial Electromagnets until the laser hits the floor, using Catwoman to hold pads in place; do this three times.
Take the final key.

achievements.description: Restore power to the bridges of Gotham City.
achievements.summary: Unlock the Mercy Bridge lockdown from the Grand Avenue Station uplink terminal.

steps.text: Cross Mercy Bridge on foot to reach Grand Avenue Station on @loc{Miagani Island}.
Clear the Militia soldiers there.
Use the uplink terminal to lift the lockdown on Mercy Bridge.

achievements.description: Obtain a key by completing the second Riddler trial.
achievements.summary: Finish the second Riddler trial and collect the key it awards.

steps.text: Return to the marked Riddler location in @loc{Chinatown}.
Move the Batmobile across the platforms with the timed boosts, then power the terminal with the Power Winch.
As Catwoman, choose the glass container on the far left, near the 'Numeracy 101' door.

achievements.description: Destroy the fourth weapons cache in Gotham City.
achievements.summary: Blow up the fourth Weapons Cache in the Chinatown sewer hideout.

steps.text: Startle Penguin's thugs near @loc{Mercy Bridge} and tail them to the hideout in @loc{Chinatown}.
Drive the @item{Batmobile} through the sewer tunnel and lower the bollards at the Bollard Control Switch.
Tear open the access door with the @mechanic{Power Winch} and defeat the thugs.
Open the vault cage and blow up the cache.

achievements.description: Defeat the Riddler in the final trial room and take him to the GCPD Precinct.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Riddler in the final trial room and take him to the GCPD Precinct.

steps.text: Complete all 243 Riddler challenges.
Return to @loc{Pinkney Orphanage} and activate the question mark on the center room's podium.
Defeat three waves of Riddler robots, hitting the Riddler between waves with the character matching his mini-shield colour.
Load him into the @item{Batmobile} and take him to the @loc{GCPD Precinct}.

achievements.description: Obtain a key by completing the fourth Riddler trial.
achievements.summary: Finish the fourth Riddler trial and collect the key it awards.

steps.text: Go to the marked location by Elliot Memorial Hospital in @loc{Bristol}.
Finish the Batmobile race course, using drifts and the tile colours to raise and lower the walls.
As Catwoman, take the key from the second container in the straight line to the left.

achievements.description: Obtain a key by completing the third Riddler trial.
achievements.summary: Finish the third Riddler trial and collect the key it awards.

steps.text: Enter the Numeracy 101 room in @loc{Pinkney Orphanage}.
Put Batman and Catwoman on their pressure plates.
Strike Catwoman's switches left to right in the numbers shown above Batman's switches: 1, 3, 5, 2, 4.
Strike Batman's switches left to right in the numbers shown above Catwoman's switches: 3, 1, 4, 5, 2.
Defeat the Riddler robots and take the key.

achievements.description: Achieve 3 minutes of drifting time in the Batmobile.
achievements.summary: Drift the Batmobile for a combined 3 minutes.

steps.text: Drift around corners and zigzag while driving the Batmobile.
Or drive in doughnuts for 3 minutes straight.

achievements.description: Give Man-Bat the final cure dose and take him to the GCPD Precinct.
achievements.summary: Give Man-Bat the final cure dose and take him to the GCPD Precinct.

steps.text: In the Creature of the Night side mission, glide into Man-Bat on @loc{Miagani Island} to take a blood sample.
Create the cure in Dr. Langstrom's lab in @loc{Chinatown}.
Once @loc{Founders' Island} is open, track Man-Bat in Detective Mode and tackle him to give the final dose.
Take Man-Bat to the @loc{GCPD Precinct}.

achievements.description: Achieve 50 critical shots on light tanks.
achievements.summary: Land 50 critical shots on Rattler tanks.

steps.text: In tank battle mode, shoot the glowing blue light next to a Rattler's main gun with the Vulcan Cannon to kill it instantly.
Keep doing this until you have 50 critical shots.

achievements.description: Achieve 23 Stars in AR Challenges.
achievements.summary: Earn 23 stars in AR Challenges as Batman.

guide.context: Each challenge counts only its best result once, so replaying it with another Batmobile adds nothing.

steps.text: Earn stars in any AR Challenges while playing as Batman, including Batmobile Race Challenges.
Keep going until your Batman star total reaches 23.

achievements.description: Deploy the Cloudburst countermeasures by protecting Ivy's plant until it hardens.
achievements.summary: Deploy the Cloudburst countermeasures by protecting Ivy's plant until it hardens.

steps.text: Use the Batmobile @mechanic{Sonar} to locate the root masses of the ancient plant.
Defend the roots from Militia attacks until Ivy hardens the plant.

achievements.description: Destroy all of the militia checkpoints.
achievements.summary: Destroy all 20 Militia checkpoints.

steps.text: Open Own the Roads from the Most Wanted wheel.
At each @loc{Militia Checkpoint}, defeat the soldiers and destroy the Commander's Checkpoint Controller.

achievements.description: Obtain a key by completing the fifth Riddler trial.
achievements.summary: Finish the fifth Riddler trial and collect the key it awards.

steps.text: Take the elevator down in the Gotham Casino in @loc{Kingston}.
Eject from the Batmobile and glide to each of the three pressure pads, gliding through the saw-blade tunnel.
As Catwoman, walk past the two containers on the left row and open the second container in the first straight line.

achievements.description: Defeat Blackfire's thugs at Lady of Gotham and take Blackfire and Jack Ryder to GCPD.
achievements.summary: Defeat Blackfire's thugs at Lady of Gotham and take Blackfire and Jack Ryder to GCPD.

steps.text: After reconnecting the Clock Tower Mainframe, go to @loc{Lady of Gotham} and defeat the thugs.
Cut power to the four Industrial Generators with the Remote Electrical Charge.
Grapnel up through the Service Hatch and take down @npc{Blackfire}.
Take Blackfire and Jack Ryder to the @loc{GCPD Precinct}.

achievements.description: Scan Gotham City to pinpoint Scarecrow's location.
achievements.summary: Use the radio towers to scan Gotham City and find where Scarecrow is making his fear gas.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{Falcone Shipping} warehouse roof and defeat the five Militia soldiers.
Free @npc{Detective Cottell}, then attach a Remote Access Device to the microwave tower.
Use the two radio towers to reveal Scarecrow's position.

achievements.description: Complete all 20 main missions again on New Story + and hand Scarecrow over at GCPD.
achievements.summary: Complete all 20 main missions again on New Story + and hand Scarecrow over at GCPD.

guide.context: New Story + makes enemies harder and removes the on-screen counter and dodge prompts.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{New Story +} after finishing the first playthrough.
Replay all 20 main missions, beat Scarecrow, and deliver him to Cash at GCPD.

achievements.description: Obtain a key by completing the sixth Riddler trial.
achievements.summary: Finish the sixth Riddler trial and collect the key it awards.

steps.text: Enter the Intro to Physics room in @loc{Pinkney Orphanage}.
Use the three pressure pads to raise the tubes so the energy ball reaches the spot above its start; some pads need both characters.
Defeat the two waves of colour-coded robots: red for Catwoman, blue for Batman.
Take the key.

achievements.description: Takedown 20 moving cars without using the Batmobile.
achievements.summary: Take down 20 moving cars on foot, without using the Batmobile.

steps.text: Take down a moving car on foot, either by baiting a Thug driver into trying to ram you and countering the car, or by gliding over a car and performing a takedown on it.
Repeat until you have taken down 20 cars.

achievements.description: Obtain a key by completing the eighth Riddler trial.
achievements.summary: Finish the eighth Riddler trial and collect the key it awards.

steps.text: Return to @loc{Pinkney Orphanage} and enter the Advanced Deathtraps room.
Use the flashing bulb on the lightbulb board to guide each character across the electrified floor, since each sees the other's safe path.
Reach the pressure pads, defeat the Riddler robots, and take the key.

achievements.description: Perform 5 perfect shots in a row with the Vulcan Gun without taking damage.
achievements.summary: Land five Perfect Shots consecutively using the Vulcan Gun, taking no damage.

guide.context: A Perfect Shot is a Critical Shot whose first shot is a direct hit; a miss makes it a plain Critical Shot.

steps.text: Unlock the Untouchable AR challenge by landing three Critical Shots with the Vulcan Gun during a tank battle.
Inside Untouchable, chain five Perfect Shots back to back and stay undamaged; each one has to hit its target directly on the first attempt.

achievements.description: Destroy all of the militia APC's.
achievements.summary: Destroy all nine Militia APCs.

steps.text: Open Armed & Dangerous from the Most Wanted wheel.
Track each APC and destroy it, ramming the escorting Militia Transports if needed.

achievements.description: Successfully complete the first Riddler trial.
achievements.summary: Successfully complete the first Riddler trial.

steps.text: Leave GCPD and start the Riddler's Revenge side mission.
Drive three laps of the Batmobile circuit in the garage.

achievements.description: Fly under 3 main bridges between the islands in one continuous glide.
achievements.summary: Pass beneath 3 of the main inter-island bridges during one unbroken glide.

guide.context: Do not use the Grapnel again after the first Grapnel Boost, or the glide is void.

steps.text: Own the Grapnel Boost Mk. IV upgrade and boost from a high point.
Glide under Mercy Bridge, Penitence Bridge and Perdition Bridge without using the Grapnel again.
Dive bomb beside each bridge and pull up to be carried underneath.

achievements.description: Apprehend the weapons dealer and lock him up in GCPD.
achievements.summary: Defeat Penguin in the final Gunrunner stage and lock him up at the GCPD Precinct.

steps.text: Go to Nightwing's location in @loc{Drescher} on Founders' Island and defeat the thugs on the rooftop.
Drop down the elevator shaft, disable the Sentry Gun with Blind Optics, and rescue Nightwing through the vent.
Defeat Penguin and take him to the @loc{GCPD Precinct}.

achievements.description: Lock up your first Supervillain in GCPD.
achievements.summary: Lock up your first supervillain at the GCPD Precinct.

steps.text: After the Panessa Studios fight, return to the @loc{GCPD Precinct} on Bleake Island.
Drop off the captured villain in the cells.

achievements.description: Stop the bank heist on Bleake Island.
achievements.summary: Stop the first bank robbery at the Bank of Gotham in Chinatown.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Bank of Gotham} in Chinatown from the Two Faced Bandit side mission.
Defeat 8 Gun Thugs before they steal all the money, then defeat the rest.

achievements.displayName: Two Sides of the Same Coin!
achievements.description: Stop the bank heist on Founders' Island.
achievements.summary: Stop the second bank robbery at the Bank of Gotham in Otisburg.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{Bank of Gotham} in Otisburg on Founders' Island.
Defeat 10 Gun Thugs, then the remaining few, until the blast doors open.

achievements.description: Use all five Batmobile weapons successfully in one tank battle.
achievements.summary: Hit with each of the five Batmobile weapons during a single tank battle.

steps.text: After Main Mission #18 (Betrayal), enter a drone tank battle.
Kill drones with the 60mm Cannon, a Vulcan Cannon critical hit, the Missile Barrage, a Drone Virus hack and the EMP.
Do all five in the same battle, which may be an AR Challenge.

achievements.description: Destroy the Cloudburst Tank in the Mettle Against Mettle mission.
achievements.summary: Destroy the Cloudburst Tank in the Mettle Against Mettle mission.

steps.text: Destroy the six @enemy{Cobra Drones} on @loc{Bleake Island}.
Scan the Cloudburst Tank and destroy its four weak points with the 60mm Cannon, evading its Overcharge.
Damage the Cloudburst on the tank's front with the 60mm and Vulcan Cannon until the tank is destroyed.

achievements.description: Take on the heavy artillery reinforcements.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Militia Cobra Drone that attacks when you leave GCPD with Ivy.

steps.text: Leave @loc{GCPD} with @npc{Poison Ivy}.
Destroy the large @enemy{Cobra Drone} that attacks.

achievements.description: Destroy all Joker Teeth, Balloons and Jack-In-the-Boxes.
achievements.summary: Destroy all 15 Joker Teeth, 10 Joker Balloons and 5 Jack-In-the-Boxes in A Matter of Family.

guide.context: Collect everything before the last story mission, because finishing it can cause a fatal error that forces a replay of the DLC.

steps.text: Shoot Joker Teeth and Joker Balloons with a Batarang, and interact with each Jack-In-the-Box.
Keep going until the counters reach 15 Teeth, 10 Balloons and 5 Boxes; the last one unlocks the achievement.

achievements.displayName: A House Made of Spun Glass
achievements.description: Free the hostages at the merry-go-round.
achievements.summary: Release the hostages held at the merry-go-round in A Matter of Family.

steps.text: Step into the middle of the merry-go-round ride and defeat the waves of Thugs in the arena.
Blow up the water tank holding the hostages with Explosive Gel.

achievements.description: Free the hostages at the Ferris wheel.
achievements.summary: Release every hostage held on the Ferris wheel in A Matter of Family.

steps.text: Defeat the Gun Thugs, then pull the brake to stop the Ferris wheel and defeat the next wave of Thugs.
Take control of the wheel with the Remote Hacking Device and rotate it to let each hostage off.

achievements.description: Free the hostages at the Ghost Ship.
achievements.summary: Release every hostage held inside the Ghost Ship in A Matter of Family.

steps.text: Hack the crane to drop its payload and open a way into the Ghost Ship.
Defeat the Thugs inside, hack the doors open, and free the first hostage.
Enter the main chamber, defeat the remaining Gun Thugs and free the rest.

achievements.description: Rescue your father.
achievements.summary: Rescue Commissioner Gordon from the Joker to finish A Matter of Family.

guide.context: Destroy all collectibles first: finishing this mission can trigger a fatal error that forces you to replay the DLC.

steps.text: Go to the door near the park entrance bomb site and follow the passage under the park.
Move containers with the Remote Hacking Device and use the Line Launcher twice to cross.
Defeat the two bosses and the Thug waves, then free Commissioner Gordon.

achievements.description: Defeat 4 enemies within a single scare effect.
achievements.summary: Take down 4 enemies during one scare effect in A Matter of Family.

steps.text: Early in the Oil Rig, grapnel above the Thugs near the damaged generator.
Trigger the scare effect with the Remote Hacking Device, then drop down and take down 4 Thugs before it ends.

achievements.description: Defeat 15 enemies using any type of hacking.
achievements.summary: Defeat 15 enemies that are being affected by hacked devices in A Matter of Family.

steps.text: Use the Remote Hacking Device on lights, scare consoles and other devices near Thugs.
Take down the affected Thugs, either with the hack or by hand, until 15 are defeated.

achievements.description: Uncover the secret history of the park.
achievements.summary: Listen to the final tape from Edward Burke after completing the park's four mini-games.

steps.text: Finish all four mini-games: Dynamic Duo match game, Bumper Car tile slide, Fish In A Barrel and High Strike, each started with the Remote Hacking Device.
Enter the door in the north wall of the water tower building, marked by a map with four lit lights.
Listen to the whole tape in the living quarters.

achievements.description: Rescue your friend.
achievements.summary: Break into the Blüdhaven Police Department as Harley Quinn and defeat Nightwing to free Poison Ivy.

steps.text: Fight through the police officers in the Blüdhaven Police Department as Harley Quinn.
Defeat @npc{Nightwing} at the end of the episode.

achievements.description: Shut down this operation.
achievements.summary: Defeat Black Mask as Red Hood in the Red Hood Story Pack.

steps.text: Fight through the three areas as Red Hood.
Defeat @npc{Black Mask} at the end of the episode.

achievements.description: Achieve 33 Stars in AR Challenges using the 1989 Movie Batmobile.
achievements.summary: Reach 33 stars in AR Challenges when driving the 1989 Movie Batmobile.

steps.text: Pick the 1989 Movie Batmobile for the Batmobile Race Challenges.
Replay Batmobile Race Challenges with it, beating the star times, until its stars add up to 33.

achievements.description: Achieve 33 Stars in AR Challenges using the 2008 Tumbler Batmobile.
achievements.summary: Reach 33 stars in AR Challenges when driving the 2008 Tumbler Batmobile.

steps.text: Pick the 2008 Tumbler Batmobile for the Batmobile Race Challenges.
Replay Batmobile Race Challenges with it, beating the star times, until its stars add up to 33.

achievements.description: Stop Penguin's escape from GCPD.
achievements.summary: Stop Penguin's escape from GCPD by defeating his thugs and apprehending him in GCPD Lockdown.

steps.text: As Nightwing, return to @loc{GCPD} on Bleake Island.
Defeat the second force of Penguin's thugs in the predator section, watching for the @enemy{Brute Mini-Gunner}.
Apprehend Penguin.

achievements.description: Achieve 33 Stars in AR Challenges using the 1960's TV Series Batmobile.
achievements.summary: Reach 33 stars in AR Challenges when driving the 1960s TV Series Batmobile.

steps.text: Pick the 1960s TV Series Batmobile for the Batmobile Race Challenges.
Replay Batmobile Race Challenges with it, beating the star times, until its stars add up to 33.

achievements.description: Break into Riddler's secret hideout and exact your revenge.
achievements.summary: Break into the Riddler's hidden robot factory in Catwoman's Revenge and finish the episode.

steps.text: Take three keycards from the @enemy{Gun Thugs} without being detected.
Defeat the remaining Gun Thugs, then open the factory door with the symbols in this order: Robot, Griffon, Warrior, Cabin.
Take the elevator down and defeat the waves of Riddler robots.
Steal all of the Riddler's money.

achievements.description: Break into Hell's Gate HQ and apprehend Two-Face.
achievements.summary: Break into Hell's Gate HQ and apprehend Two-Face in A Flip of a Coin.

steps.text: As Robin, infiltrate @loc{Hell's Gate} and defeat the thugs in the predator sections.
Solve the door puzzle with the Remote Hacking Device: one half of the busts must show the angel face and the other half the opposite face.
Defeat Two-Face.

achievements.description: Achieve 21 Stars in AR Challenges using the 2016 Batman v Superman Batmobile.
achievements.summary: Reach 21 stars in AR Challenges when driving the 2016 Batman v Superman Batmobile.

steps.text: Pick the 2016 Batman v Superman Batmobile for the Batmobile Race Challenges.
Replay Batmobile Race Challenges with it, beating the star times, until its stars add up to 21.

achievements.description: Achieve 21 Stars in AR Challenges playing as Robin.
achievements.summary: Earn 21 stars in AR Challenges as Robin.

steps.text: Choose Robin in the AR Challenges menu.
Earn 3 stars in Combat or Predator challenges, repeating until your stars as Robin add up to 21.

achievements.description: Achieve 21 Stars in AR Challenges playing as Nightwing.
achievements.summary: Earn 21 stars in AR Challenges as Nightwing.

steps.text: Choose Nightwing in the AR Challenges menu.
Earn 3 stars in Combat or Predator challenges, repeating until your stars as Nightwing add up to 21.

achievements.description: Achieve 21 Stars in AR Challenges playing as Catwoman.
achievements.summary: Earn 21 stars in AR Challenges as Catwoman.

steps.text: Choose Catwoman in the AR Challenges menu.
Earn 3 stars in Combat or Predator challenges, repeating until your stars as Catwoman add up to 21.

achievements.description: Achieve 21 Stars in AR Challenges playing as Azrael.
achievements.summary: Earn 21 stars in AR Challenges as Azrael.

steps.text: Choose Azrael in the AR Challenges menu.
Earn 3 stars in Combat or Predator challenges, repeating until your stars as Azrael add up to 21.

achievements.description: Achieve 21 Stars in AR Challenges playing as Batgirl.
achievements.summary: Earn 21 stars in AR Challenges as Batgirl.

steps.text: Choose Batgirl in the AR Challenges menu.
Earn 3 stars in Combat or Predator challenges, repeating until your stars as Batgirl add up to 21.

achievements.description: Achieve 21 Stars in AR Challenges playing as Red Hood.
achievements.summary: Earn 21 stars in AR Challenges as Red Hood.

steps.text: Choose Red Hood in the AR Challenges menu.
Earn 3 stars in Combat or Predator challenges, repeating until your stars as Red Hood add up to 21.

achievements.description: Achieve 21 Stars in AR Challenges playing as Harley Quinn.
achievements.summary: Earn 21 stars in AR Challenges as Harley Quinn.

guide.context: Harley Quinn cannot destroy weapons, so use her Mayhem Mode on rounds with many shield or stun baton enemies.

steps.text: Choose Harley Quinn in the AR Challenges menu.
Earn 3 stars in Combat or Predator challenges, repeating until your stars as Harley Quinn add up to 21.

achievements.description: Follow the assassin's trail.
achievements.summary: Trace the blood trail left by the assassin until you meet the Loyalist Assassins' leader.

steps.text: Head to the eastern tip of Miagani Island and use the Evidence Scanner on the two dead League Assassins.
Follow the blood trail to Elliot Memorial Hospital; get the Remote Electrical Charge from the GCPD Evidence Archive to open the electrified vent.
Restore power inside the hospital and find the assassin at the morgue.
Talk to the Loyalists' leader.

achievements.description: Discover the Lazarus pit.
achievements.summary: Find the new Lazarus Pit in the sewers.

steps.text: Leave Elliot Memorial Hospital and enter the Batmobile to track Lazarus energy through the sewers.
The trail crosses Mercy Bridge and ends at a sewer entrance on the Panessa Studios west shore; go in on foot.
Use the Line Launcher and Explosive Gel to reach the pit and destroy the fountain.

achievements.description: End the League of Assassins' war.
achievements.summary: End the League of Assassins' war by deciding Ra's al Ghul's fate.

guide.context: Both choices unlock the achievement.

steps.text: Return to Elliot Memorial Hospital and defeat the Loyalist Assassins.
Use the Batclaw to drop the elevator, then cross the electrified morgue water with the Line Launcher.
Meet @npc{Ra's al Ghul} and choose between handing over the cure and wrecking his life support machine.

achievements.description: Rescue Mad Hatter's first hostage.
achievements.summary: Rescue the first of Mad Hatter's three kidnapped GCPD officers.

guide.context: This mission becomes available after Main Mission #5 (Rescue Oracle).

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Mad Hatter} in Maximum Security West at the GCPD to start the mission.
Go to a marked abandoned police car and remotely defuse the explosives in its trunk to save the officer.

achievements.description: Rescue Mad Hatter's second hostage.
achievements.summary: Rescue the second of Mad Hatter's three kidnapped GCPD officers.

steps.text: Go to a second marked police car, such as the one at Panessa Studios, and remotely defuse the explosives in its trunk.

achievements.description: Lock up Mad Hatter in GCPD.
achievements.summary: Lock up Mad Hatter in the GCPD after freeing his last hostage.

steps.text: Defuse the explosives in the third police car, near the red lighthouse; it is a false lead.
Return to Maximum Security West and interact with the book of fables to enter it.
Defeat the Thugs inside to free the last officer, then lock up @npc{Mad Hatter}.

achievements.description: Interrogate the Militia Lieutenant.
achievements.summary: Interrogate the Militia Lieutenant in the Mr. Freeze Season of Infamy mission.

guide.context: This mission becomes available after Main Mission #10 (Vengeance).

steps.text: Start the final Season of Infamy mission at the fortified island south of Miagani Island and meet Mr. Freeze on his ship.
Follow the tracking device to the wharf in western Chinatown and defeat the Militia there.
Interrogate the conscious Militia Lieutenant.

achievements.description: Track down the cryopod.
achievements.summary: Track down Nora's cryopod in the Mr. Freeze Season of Infamy mission.

steps.text: Go to the Otisburg rooftop on Founders Island; disable the Jammer Pack first, then defeat the Snipers and other Militia.
Reach Nora's cryochamber.

achievements.description: Survive the Militia onslaught.
achievements.summary: Survive the Militia onslaught at Mr. Freeze's ship.

steps.text: Drive to the ship before the 1:30 timer runs out.
Survive the waves of Rattler Drones and Diamondbacks until Freeze detonates the cryogenerator.

achievements.description: Defeat the prisoners.
achievements.summary: Defeat the escaped prisoners in Iron Heights Penitentiary.

steps.text: Pick up the Freeze Blast gadget in the Quarantine Cells below Panessa Studios, then enter the crashed airship at Iron Heights Penitentiary.
Rescue the guard, then seal the steam vents with the Freeze Blast.
Defeat the freed prisoners with Nightwing's help and talk to the guard in the control room.

achievements.description: Gain access to the high security area.
achievements.summary: Collect both High Security Keycards to open the Iron Heights high security area.

steps.text: Find the first chief security officer on the crane just west of Panessa Studios and take his keycard.
Find the second on a Chinatown rooftop guarded by Thugs and take his keycard.

achievements.description: Lockup Killer Croc in GCPD.
achievements.summary: Defeat Killer Croc and lock him up in the GCPD.

steps.text: Return to Iron Heights with both keycards and go deeper into the prison.
Defeat @enemy{Killer Croc} with dual takedowns alongside Nightwing and free the Warden.
Airlift Croc to the GCPD and lock him up.

achievements.description: Achieve 21 Stars in AR Challenges using the Original Arkham Batmobile.
achievements.summary: Reach 21 stars in AR Challenges when driving the Original Arkham Batmobile.

steps.text: Pick the Original Arkham Batmobile for the Batmobile Race Challenges.
Replay Batmobile Race Challenges with it, beating the star times, until its stars add up to 21.

achievements.description: Complete the Wayne Manor AR Challenge as Batman without using any gadgets or taking any damage.
achievements.summary: As Batman, finish the Wayne Manor AR Challenge using no gadgets and taking no damage.

steps.text: Start the Wayne Manor Predator Challenge as Batman.
Defeat the Jammer Thug first; he starts at the rear of the ground floor, in its right-hand corner.
Defeat the remaining 3 Gun Thugs, Medic and Mini-Gun Brute without gadgets, the Grapnel included, or damage.

achievements.description: Complete the Batcave AR Challenge unharmed as Batman and Nightwing, using only Beat Downs.
achievements.summary: Complete the Batcave AR Challenge as Batman and as Nightwing without taking damage, using only Beat Downs.

guide.context: Camo Militia do not show in Detective Mode, so watch for them and take them out first.

steps.text: Start the Batcave Predator Challenge as Nightwing.
Stun each enemy, then mash X for the Beat Down finisher, without taking damage, until all are defeated.
Repeat the same run as Batman.

achievements.description: Complete the Silent Knight AR Challenge unharmed as Batman and Robin, using only Knockout Smashes.
achievements.summary: Complete the Silent Knight AR Challenge as Batman and as Robin without taking damage, using only Knockout Smashes.

guide.context: Take out the Medics first because they revive downed enemies.

steps.text: Start the Silent Knight Predator Challenge as Robin.
Defeat all 6 enemies, 3 Gun Thugs and 3 Medics, only with Knockout Smashes, and do not take damage.
Repeat the same run as Batman.

achievements.description: Complete the Endless Knight AR Challenge, taking out 50 Enemies as Batman.
achievements.summary: Take out 50 enemies in the Endless Knight AR Challenge as Batman.

steps.text: Start the Endless Knight Predator Challenge as Batman.
Defeat enemies by any method; you may take damage and use any gadget.
Use Inverted Takedowns and Fear Multi-Takedowns to reach 50 defeated enemies.

achievements.description: Complete the Crime Alley AR Challenge unharmed as Batman, Robin and Nightwing.
achievements.summary: Complete the Crime Alley AR Challenge as Batman, Robin and Nightwing without taking damage in any round.

guide.context: Check that the No Hit bonus shows after each round; otherwise restart.

steps.text: Start the Crime Alley Combat Challenge as Robin.
Clear all four rounds and make sure each spawned enemy shows a No Hit bonus.
Repeat as Nightwing and as Batman.

achievements.description: Flawless FreeFlow in every round of the Monarch Theatre as Batman, Robin, Nightwing and Catwoman.
achievements.summary: Finish all four rounds of the Monarch Theatre Combat Challenge with a flawless freeflow as Batman, Robin, Nightwing and Catwoman.

guide.context: Using the same Quick-Throw gadget twice in a row breaks Perfect Freeflow, even at the start of a round.

steps.text: Start the Monarch Theatre Combat Challenge as Catwoman.
In each of the four rounds, keep one combo going until the round ends and confirm the Perfect Freeflow bonus.
Repeat as Nightwing, Robin and Batman.

achievements.description: Defeat an old adversary in the Iceberg Lounge AR Challenge, playing as Batman.
achievements.summary: Defeat Killer Croc in the Iceberg Lounge AR Challenge as Batman.

guide.context: If you are killed by Killer Croc or any Thug, the challenge restarts and the 1,050,000 points start over.

steps.text: Start the Iceberg Lounge Combat Challenge as Batman.
Build combos with Disarm & Destroy and reach 1,050,000 points without being hit.
Clear the remaining enemies, then defeat @enemy{Killer Croc} with four dual-team takedowns.
